metrics.name: Network Change Compression Ratio
metrics.scope: Ratio of raw graph change events to actionable surfaced pulses (paired with 100% recall)
metrics.limitations: Measured under 25-mutation burst scenario; operational compression varies with real-time CDR volume.

metrics.name: Meaningful Syndicate Change Recall
metrics.scope: Verification that critical syndicate structural additions are not lost during noise compression

metrics.name: Evidence Coverage Rate (Claims with Traceable Source)
metrics.scope: Percentage of analytical claims directly attributed to a canonical evidence record
metrics.limitations: Based on seeded FIR/CDR source artifacts; real-world investigative records may have unparsed citations.

metrics.name: Multi-Source Corroboration Rate (>= 2 Independent Sources)
metrics.scope: Percentage of surfaced intelligence pulses backed by two or more independent data channels (CDR + FIR)

metrics.name: Unsupported Claim Rate (Hallucinated Assertions)
metrics.scope: Strict safety guarantee: ungrounded assertions without source citation must be 0%

metrics.name: Appropriate Abstention Rate (Sparse/Degraded Evidence)
metrics.scope: Verification that the analytical engine explicitly triggers INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE when data is sparse
metrics.limitations: Synthesized boundary scenarios; real investigations may exhibit nuanced partial ambiguity.

metrics.name: False Forecast Rate on Degraded Evidence
metrics.scope: Strict safety guarantee: speculative forecasts on ungrounded signals must be 0%

metrics.name: Zero Predictive Guilt Statutory Compliance
metrics.scope: Strict adherence to Indian legal constraints: zero dangerousness or recidivism scoring

metrics.name: Cryptographic Tamper Detection Rate (SHA-256)
metrics.scope: 50/50 injected payload mutations correctly identified with immutable audit event
metrics.limitations: Tests payload character mutations; does not evaluate physical storage corruption or hardware fault injection.

metrics.name: Silent Digest Overwrite Rate
metrics.scope: Verification that corrupted evidence cannot silently update authoritative canonical hashes

metrics.name: Unauthorized Action Acceptance Rate
metrics.scope: Strict resource-level RBAC: unauthorized access attempts must be rejected with 0 acceptance

metrics.name: Evidence-to-Investigator Signal Latency (p95)
metrics.scope: Complete pipeline: Ingestion -> Graph Update -> Diff -> Pulse -> Evidence Assessment -> Early Warning
metrics.limitations: Measured in-memory; production environment with remote Postgres/Neo4j and network transit will add network I/O overhead.
